overall: The AG found the Weston Forest Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by meeting on September 30 without posting notice, but found no violation by the Board because only two of five members attended, short of a quorum.

allegations.summary: A Weston Forest Committee meeting held on September 30 was allegedly held without any posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by meeting on September 30 without posting notice.

allegations.summary: Two Board of Selectmen members attended the unnoticed Committee meeting, allegedly making it a Board meeting that also required notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because a quorum of the Board is three members, there was no quorum in attendance at the Committee meeting, the Board did not deliberate, and therefore it was not required to post any notice.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance by the Committee with the Open Meeting Law
The Committee to create and approve minutes of its September 30 meeting, if not already done, within thirty (30) days of receipt of the letter
